assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 100% increase from the same period last year, driven by a sharp rise in reported cases.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 853% increase from the same period last year, indicating a significant surge in reported cases.
Mpox cases in the US are peaking with an 87% increase from the same period last year, though the number of cases has decreased compared to the previous year.
Global flu test positivity is rising with a 26% increase from the previous month, and US flu hospital admissions are up 55% from the previous month.
Polio Wikipedia readership is at the 98th percentile of the past year, indicating heightened public interest but no confirmed increase in cases.
West Nile virus cases in the US are peaking with a 1388% increase from the same period last year, indicating a sharp rise in reported cases.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising with a 45% increase from the same period last year, though the number of cases has decreased compared to the previous year.
RSV test positivity is rising with a 62% increase from the previous month, and US RSV hospital admissions are up 57% from the previous month.
Chikungunya cases in the US are at baseline with a slight increase in reported cases this year, but the first locally acquired cases were reported in Switzerland in October 2026.
US hospital admissions for COVID-19 are at baseline with a recent 13% increase from the previous month, and Wikipedia readership is at the 20th percentile of the past year.
US reported cases of pertussis are rising, with a 55% increase over the past 8 months, and 12,586 cases this year compared to 30,326 by the same time last year.
Wikipedia readership for Group A strep is at the 50th percentile of the past year, indicating moderate public interest.
US reported cases of hepatitis A are at baseline with a 10% increase over the past 8 months, and 630 cases this year compared to 941 by the same time last year.
US reported cases of malaria are at baseline with a 30% increase over the past 8 months, and 1,161 cases this year compared to 1,448 by the same time last year.
Wikipedia readership for human metapneumovirus is at the 35th percentile of the past year, indicating moderate public interest.
